description: This Java class 'NetworkChangeNotifier' manages network state updates and observers in Chrome, including auto-detection and manual simulation of network changes, and communicates with native code via JNI.

classes.name: NetworkChangeNotifier
classes.description: Manages network state updates, observers, and JNI communication for network changes in Chrome.

classes.name: NetworkChangeNotifier.ConnectionTypeObserver
classes.description: Interface for observing connection type changes.
